messages.subject: mardiaKurtosis
parts:
Hello,

My apologies if this is not the right forum to ask this question. I was unable to find a semTools help forum. I am trying to get the Mardia kurtosis coefficient for a multi-item scale using the mardiaKurtosis() command. I created a separate data set from the main data set that includes only the items from the scale as follows:

missvar1 <- c("T6MISS1", "T6MISS2", "T6MISS3", "T6MISS4", "T6MISS5", "T6MISS6", "T6MISS7", "T6MISS8", "T6MISS9", "T6MISS10")
cfa.miss <- MISS.CFA[missvar1]

I then used the new data set with the mardiaKurtosis command as follows:

mardiaKurtosis(cfa.miss)

The following results were returned:

b2d   z   p
 NA  NA  NA

I'm guessing that since I didn't get an error message, the programming ran, but I am not sure what the NA results mean. I greatly appreciate the assistance.

Thank you,

Ryan

messages.author: 5abdb409f213d464
messages.subject: Re: mardiaKurtosis
parts:
Missing values? Then use mardiaKurtosis(na.omit(cfa.miss)). Alternatively, you can utilize the MVN package, which provides some additional coefficients.
